001: Have you met your roommates at the residence yet?
Yes, a few of them. They're really nice, although I still don't know their names.
Same for me. The girl in the room next door is named Marta.
Oh, Marta! She's very pleasant. She helped me with the washing machine yesterday.
That's great. Seems like there's a good atmosphere on the floor.
Yeah, honestly, I feel pretty comfortable here.
002: Hey, where can you have dinner around here at night?
There's a dining hall on the ground floor, but it closes at nine.
What if we arrive late? Is there another option?
We can use the shared kitchen on the second floor.
Really? I didn't know there was a kitchen.
Yeah, it's at the end of the hallway. It has a microwave and an electric stove.
003: I can't find the study room. Can you point me in the right direction?
Sure, it's on the third floor, right next to the library.
Is it open at this hour?
Yes, until twelve at night. It's usually pretty quiet in there.
Perfect, then I'll go for a bit before sleeping.
Good idea. I also need to review some notes.
004: The noise from the street won't let me sleep. Does that happen to you?
Sometimes, yeah. That's why I bought some earplugs.
And do they work well? I'm thinking about buying them.
Pretty well, honestly. I sleep much better since I started using them.
Thanks for the tip. I'll look for them first thing tomorrow.
You're welcome. If you want, I can show you the store where I bought them.
005: How does the laundry system at the residence work?
You have to book a time slot on the app and then pay with your card.
And how much does each wash cost?
Two euros and fifty cents, I believe. The drying is free.
Great, so I don't have to go to the laundromat outside.
Exactly. Plus, the machines are pretty new.
006: Do you mind if I open the window? I need some fresh air.
No, not at all. It's really stuffy in here.
It's just that the radiator heats up too much and I don't know how to adjust it.
There's a valve on the side. It usually has three settings.
Oh, okay. I'll try setting it to the middle position.
That'll be better. That way we won't be too cold or too hot.
007: I saw there's a bulletin board at the entrance. What is it for?
For signing up for activities, buying second-hand things, stuff like that.
Really? Well, I'm going to take a look this afternoon.
You should. Sometimes they post really good deals on furniture or books.
I actually need a lamp for my desk.
Well, keep an eye out, because the other day I saw a really cheap one.
008: Do you know if there's a schedule for the shared showers?
There's no fixed schedule, but there's usually fewer people early in the morning.
Okay, then I'll try to get up earlier so I don't have to wait.
Good idea. Plus, the hot water works better in the morning.
That's a plus. I hate showers with cold water.
Ha, ha. Well, there you go, you'll have to get up a little early.
009: Have you tried the breakfast at the dining hall yet?
Yeah, this morning. It's not bad, but the coffee is a bit weak.
Same for me. I prefer making it myself in the room.
Well, I bought a small coffee maker for the room.
And they haven't banned it? I thought you weren't allowed to use them.
They haven't said anything so far. I keep it well hidden.
010: How's it going living with your roommate?
Really well, honestly. He's tidy and pretty respectful.
I'm glad. Sometimes it's hard to share a space with a stranger.
Yeah, but we set some basic rules and everything is going smoothly.
Well, just letting each other know if we're going to be late and not making noise at night.
